entry.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
entry.summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

entry.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
entry.summary: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

entry.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
entry.summary: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

entry.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
entry.summary: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

entry.title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
entry.summary: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

entry.title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
entry.summary: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

entry.title: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
entry.summary: Anthropic’s IPO made FTX’s liquidated AI bet a $43 billion what-if, just as Netflix premiered its Sam Bankman-Fried drama.

entry.title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
entry.summary: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

entry.title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
entry.summary: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.

entry.title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
entry.summary: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

entry.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60K as Crypto Fear Index Hits Worst Level Since February
entry.summary: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 Friday as crypto sentiment collapsed and AI-linked stocks sank after Anthropic’s IPO.

entry.title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
entry.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.

entry.summary: A (brief) win for Anthropic's ANT stock on IPO day meant a loss for just about every other major asset class.

entry.title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
entry.summary: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.

entry.summary: Thursday's ETF outflow was the funds' biggest in three weeks, as rising Treasury yields and Fed rate hike bets weigh on crypto.

entry.title: Coinbase Targets In-House Prediction Markets by First Half of 2027: Report
entry.summary: The exchange offers event contracts through Kalshi, but running its own would give it more control and a bigger share of trading revenue.

entry.title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
entry.summary: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

entry.title: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street
entry.summary: Anthropic shares surged on their Nasdaq debut, but stocks slid and Bitcoin fell lower. Its daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum, a strong downtrend, and fragile support.
